title: v5.2.4 — Labels + Notifications + Accessibility
message: Renamed 'News' to 'Update Log', 'Feedback' to 'Send Feedback', 'Sign In' to 'Log In', and 'Customize' to 'Gameplay' (it controls gameplay settings, not cosmetics). Four new notifications: achievement unlocked, new friend added you, friend leveled up, and bank interest earned. New Reduce Motion toggle in Look & Sound kills all animations for an accessibility-friendly experience. Fixed streak notification firing multiple times per day due to a timezone bug.
